name: winui-svelte-vscode
description: Previews and completes winui-svelte's Fluent icons, colors and installed fonts in .svelte files, and turns a component's props into the CSS that sets the same value
author: Avi

commands.title: Convert winui-svelte Attributes to CSS in This File

enumDescriptions: Move a converted prop to a rule in the <style> block, with a class on the tag
Write a converted prop as a style: directive on the tag
winuiSvelte.destination.description: Where a prop that has a CSS counterpart goes when it is converted

winuiSvelte.resourceHints.description: Complete the WinUI resource names written as var(--name), and show a light and dark swatch of a color resource in the hover and the list

winuiSvelte.previews.gradient.description: Show a bar of the stops beside a linear-gradient() or radial-gradient() and a LinearGradientBrush

winuiSvelte.previews.contrast.description: Show the WCAG contrast ratio and its AA or AAA verdict after a text color that sits with a background color in the same rule or tag

winuiSvelte.previews.easing.description: Show the curve of a cubic-bezier(), steps(), linear(), named easing or KeySpline, and the timeline of a transition or animation in the hover

winuiSvelte.previews.box.description: Show the box model of padding, margin, border-width and border-radius, and the tracks of a grid, in the hover (pixels only)

winuiSvelte.previews.declaration.description: Show in the hover of a CSS declaration the WinUI property it becomes, or why it has no WinUI meaning

winuiSvelte.previews.media.description: Show after an @media condition whether it holds in the assumed environment below

winuiSvelte.previews.shadow.description: Show the shadow depth ladder in the hover of -winui-elevation and box-shadow, and the material of a backdrop

winuiSvelte.previews.picture.description: Show the picture beside the path of every prop, option or object key the library types as a picture (an icon, an image source), and a larger hover with its name, size and frames; a missing file gets a warning

winuiSvelte.previews.remotePictures.description: Preview remote pictures (http and https URLs): fetched with a timeout, a size cap and an on-disk cache; off by default so that nothing is fetched without your say

winuiSvelte.media.reducedMotion.description: Whether the @media preview assumes reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion)

winuiSvelte.media.width.description: The window width in pixels the @media preview assumes

winuiSvelte.media.height.description: The window height in pixels the @media preview assumes
